Hi critters,

I've been working for a group at Tufts University that studies gerrymandering, and we're looking for someone to join our team on the web development/web-mapping side. Maybe this is a good fit for you or a former student? Details here <https://mggg.org/jobs>.

A little additional context/my mini recruitment pitch: The group is awesome, with a lot of strong feminist voices and feminist perspectives integrated into what we do, and it's a super queer friendly workplace. This spring/summer we're doing a ton of community mapping with states, voting rights groups, and civil rights groups to support grassroots input into the mess that is redistricting in the US. Feel free to reach out with questions.

cheers,
Heather

messages.subject_clean: UC San Diego R Users group hackathon mentorship opportunity over spring break...
messages.body_plain:
Hi folks,
If you are interested in participating, please see the survey below, and feel free to contact Erin or Chase.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Dear R-users group,
> I know this is on short notice but we are looking for graduate students and post-docs who are interested in working with undergraduates over spring break. UCSD is hoping to keep undergraduates engaged and safe during spring break and are offering Spring Break Research Experiences. We are designing an experience where teams of undergraduates led by graduate students/post-docs will work collaboratively to develop web-based data visualizations using CalCOFI data. Similar to a coding "hack-a-thon" the goal of this experience will be to develop new and interesting ways to showcase CalCOFI's amazing repository of physical, chemical, and biological data, with the hope that the projects done this week may later be implemented on the new CalCOFI website. If you are interested in helping out with this spring break experience or working on opportunities like this in the future, please fill out the form here: https://forms.gle/sFL519ie5FHT9NJ86 <https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://forms.gle/sFL519ie5FHT9NJ86__;!!Mih3wA!QV2WXCvMILDdQyPUjuQ5tErvXAbZW5-Jrk1w_0PplwS5Ap5CNaHE1X9tw7nB3HYIUw$>. Once we get a sense of interest we'll organize a zoom meeting or two next week to get everyone ready!
>
> Best,
> Erin Satterthwaite
> CalCOFI Coordinator

--

messages.subject: Work group tomorrow (3/30) from 10-12PDT
messages.body_plain:
Hi R Users,

Welcome back to Spring Term! We are starting up D-RUG meetings again this term, and hope to see you all there. This week, we will be meeting on Tuesday, March 30th from 10-12PDT (zoom link below). However, starting next week we will be meeting on Monday mornings from 10-12 PDT.

To clarify, we will be hosting a virtual workgroup:

Tuesday, March 30th 10-12PDT
Monday, April 5th 10-12 PDT
Monday, April 13th 10-12PDT
...etc. every Monday until the end of term.

Zoom link for Tuesday (3/30) meeting: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/91815239430?pwd=eTlpQ1AremNhQkxkNDM1Y2luV2dLdz09

Finally, if you cannot make it to our meetings this term, remember that you can always post any questions to our awesome discourse site <https://d-rug.discourse.group/>.

Cheers!
D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
